item.title: Projects Title Section
item.description: The main title page has styling like the other title sections. It uses a fullwidth divi section that contains a fullwidth header element. Fullwidth Section The fullwidth section uses ‘rennie-kendrick-uo-science-lab.jpg’ as a background image. Because of the cosmic-wp-v2 theme, there is custom CSS to pull the image across the page. it looks like this: width: 82.5vw; margin-left: calc(-32vw + 50%); This is setting the image to fit 82.5% of the viewport, and the second line is centering the image.

item.title: Title Section

item.title: Main Title Section
item.description: The main title page has styling like the other title sections. It uses a fullwidth divi section that contains a fullwidth header element. Fullwidth Section The fullwidth section uses ‘rennie-kendrick-uo-science-lab.jpg’ as a background image. Because of the cosmic-wp-v2 theme, there is custom CSS to pull the image across the page. it looks like this: width: 75vw; margin-left: calc(-35vw + 50%); This was a bit finicky, but essentially it is setting the image to fit 75% of the viewport, and the second line is centering the image.
